title: Analyse Podcast #61 (Bernard Leong) — Eric: 'success makes you a target worth capturing'
summary: Bernard Leong runs Eric on Analyse Podcast #61 for a global business + tech audience, framing the conversation around the chapter the Lean Startup missed — why mission-driven companies become more vulnerable, not less, once they succeed.
blockquote: We're helping people create this asset, and we're teaching them the wrong idea. We're teaching them that success will protect them. But, that's backwards. Success makes you a target worth capturing.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on Analyse Podcast (Bernard Leong)
